view: Silver and gold fell again on 25 November (Silver BeES −5.5%, Gold BeES −2.9%) ahead of US inflation data. That data, out tonight, showed October core PCE inflation at 3.3% against 3.2% expected, cementing expectations of a December US rate rise, which has been the main pressure on bullion.
watch: The 8–9 December Fed decision and the dollar.

view: A global sell-off in AI stocks hit Asian hardware names today (Taiwan −6.2%, Korea over 5%), weighing on AI-server maker Netweb, while Indian IT services stocks rose (Nifty IT +1.3%).
Record copper prices drove Hindustan Copper's profit surge, but copper has since slipped to a five-month low on a strong dollar and weak China data, dragging metal stocks.
